about.title: About Veteran Electric
text: Our commercial and residential electricians possess years of first hand experience in the industry, making our team the most extensively-trained collection of industry-certified professionals in the region. We are constantly keeping up with the latest technology and advances in the field, utilizing them for your project. With our skilled hands taking care of things, you can always rest easy.

Our ultimate goal is to ensure the safety of you and your family when it comes to your residential electrical issues. We are fully licensed and insured and pride ourselves in quality work. Don’t take a chance on your electric jobs with non-licensed companies.

We have been serving the Houston area since 2013. View our service area by map or zip code HERE. To find out more about our installation and electrical repair services, please contact us at 281-631-9770, today.
